hook.say: Asia edition! The biggest continent hides some real surprises. Which is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Japan or UK?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Japan or the U K?
questions.fact: Japan is more than one and a half times the size of the UK.
questions.sayAnswer: Japan! It is more than one and a half times the size of the United Kingdom.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Mexico or Kazakhstan?
questions.fact: Kazakhstan is almost 40% bigger than Mexico.
questions.sayAnswer: Kazakhstan! It is almost forty percent bigger than Mexico.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Thailand or France?
questions.fact: Mainland France is about 8% bigger than Thailand.
questions.sayAnswer: France! Mainland France is about eight percent bigger than Thailand.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Iran or Mongolia?
questions.fact: Iran is about 5% bigger than Mongolia.
questions.sayAnswer: Iran! It is about five percent bigger than Mongolia.

questions.q: Which is bigger: North Korea or South Korea?
questions.fact: North Korea is about 20% bigger, with half as many people.
questions.sayAnswer: North Korea! It is about twenty percent bigger than the South, with half as many people.
